units.source_text: 夕雾左大臣原定于本月内将六女公子嫁与匂亲王。

en.t: Minister of the Left Yugiri had originally planned to marry his sixth daughter to Prince Niou within this month.

units.source_text: 现在匂亲王迎接了这个意外的人来，表示“先下手为强”，

en.t: Now Prince Niou had received this unexpected woman, as if to show that the one who acts first gains the advantage,

units.source_text: 摆脱了六女公子，左大臣心中非常不快。

en.t: and had freed himself from the sixth young lady, which made the Minister of the Left extremely displeased.

units.source_text: 匂亲王闻知此事，甚是抱歉，便时时写信去慰问。

en.t: When Prince Niou heard of this, he felt very sorry and often wrote letters to console them.

units.source_text: 六女公子的着裳仪式早已准备，其隆重盛称于世。

en.t: The coming-of-age ceremony for the sixth young lady had long since been prepared, and its magnificence was widely praised.

units.source_text: 现在如果延期，势必受人讥笑，因此决定于二十日后举行。

en.t: If it were postponed now, people would surely laugh at them, so it was decided that it would be held twenty days later.

units.source_text: 左大臣想起：“薰中纳言是同族人，和他攀亲不甚体面。

en.t: The Minister of the Left thought, "Counselor Kaoru is one of our own clan, so making a marriage alliance with him would not look very proper.

units.source_text: 然而把此人让给别人做女婿，实甚可惜，

en.t: Still, it would be a great pity to let someone else have such a man as a son-in-law,

units.source_text: 还不如把六女公子嫁给了他吧。

en.t: so perhaps it would be better to marry the sixth young lady to him.

units.source_text: 他近年来偷偷地钟爱的那个大女公子已经死去，他正在寂寞悲伤呢。”

en.t: The elder young lady whom he had secretly loved in recent years has already died, and he is lonely and grieving now."

units.source_text: 便托一个相当的人，向薰中纳言探询意见。

en.t: He therefore asked a suitable person to inquire into Counselor Kaoru's feelings.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言答道：“我眼前但见人世无常之相，觉得人生实在可厌。

en.t: Counselor Kaoru replied, "Before my eyes I see only the impermanence of this world, and life seems truly hateful to me.

units.source_text: 况且此身也有不吉之感，故此种事情，千万不要提起。”

en.t: Moreover, I feel there is something ill-omened about myself, so please do not mention such matters under any circumstances."
He made it clear that he had absolutely no intention of marrying.

units.source_text: 左大臣听了，恨恨地说：“岂有此理！

en.t: When the Minister of the Left heard this, he said bitterly, "How can this be reasonable?

units.source_text: 我卑躬屈膝地自荐，连这个人也拒绝起我来了？”

en.t: I humbled myself and made the offer on my own, and now even this man rejects me?"

units.source_text: 两人虽是手足之亲，但因薰中纳言人品之高超令人敬畏，故亦不敢相强。

en.t: Although the two men were as close as brothers, Counselor Kaoru's noble character inspired such awe that the Minister did not dare to press him.
